name: Chromatic four-fret walk
description: One finger per fret on four adjacent frets. Move up one fret at a time with tiny motions and an even pulse — no squeezing the neck.

fretboard_guide.caption: Index, middle, ring, pinky. Keep fingers close to the frets.

name: Single-string chromatic pairs
description: On one string, play two notes per fret sliding the pair up the neck. Keep pick strokes small and alternate steadily.

fretboard_guide.caption: First chromatic pair on the G string — slide this two-fret shape up the neck. Index (blue) on fret 5, middle (green) on fret 6.

name: Chromatic position hop
description: Play a short chromatic cell, then shift the whole shape up one position. Focus on landing clean without rushing the shift.

fretboard_guide.caption: Play frets 5-6-7-8, then shift up and play 6-7-8-9. Primary position (solid rings), secondary position (dashed).

name: Spider crawl — adjacent frets
description: Spider pattern: each finger gets one fret on adjacent strings, walking up and back. Keep fingertips curved and shoulders relaxed.

fretboard_guide.caption: The 'Spider' walk. Maintain finger independence across strings.

name: Spider — skip-a-string variant
description: Same spider idea but leave one string silent between played pairs to wake up independent fingers.

name: Two-string skip arpeggio
description: Pick a low note then a note two strings higher, alternating slowly. Aim for identical volume on each string.

name: Half-step bend and release
description: Sustain a note, bend up a half step to pitch, release with control. Use ears first — match a reference tone if you can hum it.

name: Long-tone vibrato
description: Hold a comfortable note and add narrow vibrato from the wrist. Keep pitch center stable — motion is side to side, not wild.

name: Hammer-on pull-off pairs
description: Trill two frets on one string using only fretting hand. Start painfully slow; demand equal volume on each note.

name: Eighth-note grid tap
description: Mute strings lightly and tap eighth notes on the click or a metronome. Expose rushing by exaggerating the downbeat mentally.

name: Two-note call and response
description: Play a short two-note question, answer it an octave or fifth away. Think singing phrases, not exercises.

name: Unison intonation check
description: Match the same pitch on two strings in different positions. Listen for beats — adjust until the wobble slows.

name: Blues shuffle limber
description: Loose wrist, light shuffle subdivision on muted strings — feel the long-short pair without locking the elbow.

name: Rock downstroke accents
description: Palm-muted eighths with accents on beats two and four. Keep the quiet notes truly quiet so accents pop.

name: Shell voicing finger roll
description: Roll through three-note shells on adjacent strings — no strum, just sequential pressure. Think piano voice-leading.

name: Gallop primer
description: Slow gallop rhythm: long-short-short picking on one note. Relax the picking shoulder; speed comes from small motion.

name: Travis picking open strings
description: Thumb alternates bass strings while fingers pluck top strings on a steady grid. Keep thumb volume even.

name: Even eighth pop groove
description: Muted percussive eighths with a tiny dynamic swell into the downbeat of every other bar.

name: Neutral legato glide
description: Connect three notes on one string with hammer-ons only, then reverse with pull-offs. No pick after the first attack.

name: Comfort stretch — four frets
description: One finger per fret on a comfortable stretch. Hold briefly, release tension between reps — never fight pain.

name: Slonimsky Tritone Shift
description: Play 1-2-3-4, then shift your hand up 6 frets (a tritone) and repeat. Focus on the precision of the shift.

fretboard_guide.caption: Focus on the 6-fret jump between the index finger positions.

name: Slonimsky Interpolated Chromatic
description: Play the frets in 1-3-2-4 order. This breaks the 'linear' habit and wakes up the ring and middle finger independence.

fretboard_guide.caption: Sequence: Index -> Ring -> Middle -> Pinky.

name: Slonimsky Infrapolated Major 3rd
description: Root -> Half-step below -> Major 3rd above. A classic 'outside' sound that stretches the fingers.

fretboard_guide.caption: G -> F# -> B. Notice the triangular finger shape.

name: Interpolation 1-3-2-4 (D string)
description: Four consecutive frets played in 1-3-2-4 finger order on the D string. Builds ring-finger independence.

fretboard_guide.caption: Index (fret 3), Ring (fret 5), Middle (fret 4), Pinky (fret 6).

name: Interpolation 1-4-2-3 (A string)
description: Index-to-pinky stretch on the A string: 1-4-2-3. Hand must open for the wide span.

fretboard_guide.caption: Index → Pinky → Middle → Ring. Notice the hand opens for the index-to-pinky stretch.

name: Interpolation 1-3-4-2 (G string)
description: Ring then pinky before the middle finger on the G string. Subtle reorder that breaks autopilot.

fretboard_guide.caption: Index → Ring → Pinky → Middle. Ring-pinky pair comes before the middle.

name: Interpolation 2-4-1-3 (B string)
description: Starts on the middle finger, resetting hand position. Forces the index to stretch back.

fretboard_guide.caption: Middle → Pinky → Index → Ring. Hand resets with middle finger anchor.

name: Interpolation 1-2-4-3 (low E string)
description: Pinky before ring in close succession on the low E. Demands control from the last two fingers.

fretboard_guide.caption: Index → Middle → Pinky → Ring. Pinky lands before ring in the upper frets.

name: Infrapolation — root → b2 → P4
description: Root, half-step below, then leap a perfect fourth above. Clean landing after the approach note.

fretboard_guide.caption: Approach from fret 4 (Bb), root on fret 5 (B), leap to fret 10 (E).

name: Infrapolation — root → b2 → P5
description: Half-step approach with a perfect fifth leap. Requires stable hand frame across the wider interval.

fretboard_guide.caption: Approach fret 4 (F#), root fret 5 (G), leap to fret 12 (D). Pinky for the stretch.

name: Infrapolation — root → b2 → m7
description: Wide minor seventh leap after the half-step approach. Opens the hand across a large interval.

fretboard_guide.caption: Fret 3 (Ab) → fret 4 (A) on A string, then leap to fret 4 (G) on D string. Pinky lands the m7.

name: Infrapolation — root → b2 → M7
description: Maximum stretch infrapolation: half-step below, then leap a major seventh. Extreme finger independence.

fretboard_guide.caption: Fret 3 (G) → fret 4 (Ab) on low E, then leap to fret 4 (A) on A string. Major seventh stretch.

name: Infrapolation — root → b2 → P4 (low E)
description: Deep register infrapolation on the low E string. Rich overtones from the lower positions.

fretboard_guide.caption: Fret 1 (F) → fret 2 (F#) on low E, then leap to fret 7 (B). P4 landing.

name: Tritone sequence — ascending 4-note
description: Four-note ascending cell shifted up a tritone. Focus on the clean 6-fret position shift.

fretboard_guide.caption: Play frets 2-3-4-5 on G string, shift up 6 frets, play 8-9-10-11.

name: Tritone sequence — descending 4-note
description: Descending 4-note cell shifted by tritone. Landing cleanly after the slide is the challenge.

fretboard_guide.caption: Descend 5-4-3-2 on D string, then 11-10-9-8. Pinky leads the descent.

name: Tritone sequence — 3-note × 3 shifts
description: Three-note cell shifted by tritone three times. Rapid-fire position changes across the neck.

fretboard_guide.caption: 3-note cells at frets 3-5, 9-11, 15-17 on B string. Three tritone shifts.

name: Tritone sequence — 4-note × 3 shifts
description: Four-note cell shifted by tritone, then again. Covers extensive fretboard territory.

fretboard_guide.caption: Cells at frets 1-4, 7-10, 13-16 on A string. Three positions across the neck.

name: Tritone sequence — cross-string
description: Four-note ascending cell on low E, tritone shift to the A string. Adds string change complexity.

fretboard_guide.caption: Cell on low E (frets 1-4), tritone shift to A string (frets 4-7). String change mid-sequence.

name: Compound — interpolated tritone shift
description: 1-3-2-4 interpolated cell shifted by tritone. Combines finger independence with position shifting.

fretboard_guide.caption: 1-3-2-4 at frets 3-6, then tritone shift to frets 9-12 on D string.

name: Compound — infrapolation with descending tail
description: Infrapolation leap (root→b2→M3) followed by a three-note chromatic descent. Attack then recover.

fretboard_guide.caption: Infrapolation: fret 4→5 on A string, leap to fret 4 on D. Then descend 4-3-2 on D string.

name: Compound — two-string interpolated shift
description: 1-3-2-4 on A string, repeat with tritone shift on D string. Two-voice independence with string crossing.

fretboard_guide.caption: 1-3-2-4 on A string (frets 3-6), then same pattern shifted on D string (frets 6-9).
